name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 21, introductory part – Am 117
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 21. Rejects any increase above the Council position for the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund and the European Union Agency for Asylum; considers that expenditure under Heading 4 must instead prioritise the effective protection of the Union’s external borders, including physical border infrastructure and surveillance, the prevention of illegal entry and the return of persons with no right to remain; supports appropriations for the Border Management and Visa Instrument and eu-LISA only insofar as they directly and measurably serve those objectives; rejects the use of Union funds for relocation and resettlement schemes, for measures liable to create incentives for illegal migration or for measures encroaching upon the Member States’ competence to determine their asylum and immigration policies;
